title: log-likelihoods not competitive with other likelihood-based models
description: Despite good sample quality, the proposed diffusion models achieve log-likelihoods that are not competitive with those of autoregressive models, flows, or VAEs.
canonical_description: model log-likelihoods not competitive with other likelihood-based generative models

evidence.quote: Despite their sample quality, our models do not have competitive log likelihoods compared to other likelihood-based models
